patterns.name: Phased Refactoring for scope=all
patterns.description: Break large-scale refactoring into discrete functional phases with validation checkpoints. Each phase maintains system stability and allows incremental rollback.
patterns.approach:
1. Analyze codebase for refactoring opportunities
2. Create phase breakdown strategy (layer-based, component-based, complexity-based, or dependency-based)
3. Execute each phase with: checkpoint commit → plan approval → execute → validate → phase commit
4. Mandatory zero-tolerance validation between phases (0 errors, 0 warnings)
5. Independent rollback capability per phase
6. Final cross-phase validation and documentation
risks: Test code may have custom implementations not suitable for extraction
Previous refactorings may have already addressed opportunities
mitigations: Verify before extracting - check if patterns are truly identical
Review git history and checkpoint.json for completed refactorings
Start with low-risk phases (documentation, comments) before structural changes
Skip phases where previous work is sufficient

implementation_notes.phase_1_low_risk: Documentation cleanup, TODO marker updates, XML documentation - minimal risk
implementation_notes.phase_2_test_consolidation: Test helper extraction - RISK: Custom implementations may not be compatible
implementation_notes.phase_3_service_layer: Service consolidation - Check if already done (e.g., HtmlTransformPatterns.cs)
implementation_notes.phase_4_debug_infrastructure: Verify debug markers standardization - may already be complete
implementation_notes.phase_5_documentation: Final integration and learning pattern updates
